name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Quality growth compounders focused on AI infrastructure and semiconductor supply chain, leveraging foundational and enabling positions distinct from mega-cap concentration.
reassessment_note: Previous thesis—value compounders positioned for rising-rate environment with energy carry and financial NIM expansion—has not materialized. Fed raised rates 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16, but macro environment shows tech growth remains dominant driver (S&P 500 +7.7% YTD on AI capital spending boom per JPMorgan research). Current book down 1.89% vs SPY +3.26% in 3 weeks signals thesis failure: Energy Select (XLE) down 3.55% despite 44.89% YTD sector gain; EIA forecasts oil price compression ($90→$74 in 2027); dividend valuations remain compressed even with rates higher; financial sector (XLF down 5.09%) shows no expected NIM benefit. Conversely, semiconductor infrastructure enabling AI deployment shows structural strength: Broadcom AI revenue up 221% YoY to 56% of total, guidance to $230B by 2028; TSM monopoly on advanced nodes; Qualcomm building $15B data center business. Pivot to AI infrastructure while maintaining quality bar and sub-50% novelty overlap (0% overlap with R2 achieved).

positions.thesis: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue at 56% of total, growing 221% YoY; Q3 FY26 total revenue up 85.5%, guidance to $21.7B Q4 AI revenue and $115B fiscal 2027. Dominant networking and switching position for data center AI infrastructure. Quality compounder with pricing power and structural growth.

Taiwan Semiconductor near-monopoly on advanced node manufacturing for AI chips (GPUs, ASICs). Raised FY2026 guidance. Foundational to entire AI infrastructure expansion. Exceptional competitive moat with 3-5 year technology lead on competitors. Quality industrial compounder.

Qualcomm building $15B data center business by fiscal 2029 from near-zero, targeting massive TAM expansion. Currently 25% below 52-week high despite 15.44% YTD gain; market underestimating data center opportunity. Mobile leadership provides stable cash flow funding growth. Leveraged optionality.

Applied Materials chip equipment supplier with 40%+ gross margins benefits directly from semiconductor capacity expansions driven by AI demand. Critical enabling role in manufacturing bottleneck; no substitutes. Quality industrial compounder with high barriers to entry.

CrowdStrike cloud-native cybersecurity with AI-powered threat detection. Falcon platform gaining enterprise share as digital transformation and AI deployment accelerate security requirements. SaaS recurring model, expanding margins, cloud-native competitive moat. High growth quality compounder.

Adobe leadership in creative software with generative AI integration (Firefly, Generative Fill) across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Subscription recurring revenue with strong pricing power for AI-enhanced features. Quality SaaS compounder with switching costs.

ASML monopoly on extreme ultraviolet lithography equipment critical to sub-5nm semiconductor manufacturing. Faces zero competition; provides irreplaceable enabling technology for every advanced AI chip. Strategic asset in global semiconductor supply chain. Quality industrial compounder.

iShares PHLX Semiconductor ETF provides diversified exposure to ecosystem beyond core four positions. Balanced exposure to fabless, foundry, equipment, and materials companies. Index up 100% YTD, supporting quality momentum thesis. Reduces single-stock volatility.
